part: main loop: Condition and direction, students
question: Do heads trained on Jev's engine readings read held-out engine stories as well as heads trained on Clef's readings, both scored against Clef's reading?
one_change: train on Jev's engine readings in place of Clef's readings, same stories, folds and features

baseline.model: T122 heads trained on Clef's readings, all readings per fold, full text, presence AUROC

prediction.metric: presence AUROC of the Jev-trained heads scored against Clef's reading on held-out folds
prediction.why: the Clef-trained heads gave 0.8553 on these stories and folds (runs/pulse/t122/t122_curve.json); Jev's readings agree with Clef's on presence 0.7748 over all stories (runs/pulse/t130/t130_jev_engine.json), so label noise should lower the Jev-trained figure; pass test written before the run: the paired 95 percent interval of Jev-trained minus Clef-trained presence AUROC lies above -0.02, otherwise Jev's readings are not a drop-in training source; no hosted call, CPU only
